name: Xtile By Xenlism
description: Architect widget for the Xtile family: an empty launcher tile whose edit-mode toolbar gains an "Add Widget" icon. Clicking it opens a dialog to name a new tile and search for an installed app, then creates a real Xtile Child configured for that app - no manual .desktop path editing needed. Xtile Firefox/Chrome/Terminal/GIMP/Inkscape remain separate bundled presets; this is the generic version for any app.
author: Nattapong Pullkhow
